# Smook's Police Gear Pack

::youtube{#_BxDXNCSjBQ}

# What is it?

This mod adds a bunch of police uniforms and armor to the game. Specifically 4 different versions in 3 different types:

* Las Vegas Police Department
* Sheriff
* Freelance Police
* New Vegas Milk Company

# Where to get them?

There's an industrial grade shipment of each inside of a respawning crate in the Nevada Highway Patrol Station

# Credits:

[mrconvict](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrconvict?gameId=130 "mrconvict") for the Uniform mesh and Sheriff Uniform textures.

[nofear88](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nofear88?gameId=130 "nofear88") for the LVPD Uniform textures.

[Testudini](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Testudini?gameId=130 "Testudini") for the NVMC Milkman textures.

[eric3844](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/eric3844?gameId=130 "eric3844") for the Shoulder Harness mesh.

Me for the Freelance Police textures and various texture and mesh edits.
tags: Adds a bunch of police uniforms and armor to the game.

# **The hell is this?**

This mod Adds an Enclave General's uniform and hat to the game. Pretty much exactly what it says on the can.

# **Where to get em?**

They can be found inside a locker in the Remnants Bunker. They can also be spawned into the game with the following console commands (Replace XX with the mod's current load order number, you know the drill.)

| player.additem XX000BF8 1     | **Enclave General Outfit** |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| **player.additem XX000BF9 1** | **Enclave General Cap**    |

Pipe can be downloaded right [here.](https://degmods. "here.")

[**eric3844**](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/eric3844 "eric3844") for the armband mesh.

[**Andragorn**](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Deleted432558User "Andragorn") for the medal cord mesh.

::youtube{#mTNYwHxfqcQ}

# **What ya got there?**

This mod adds equipable 1950s J.R. "Bob" Dobbs style tobacco pipes to the game, complete with working smoke effects. Comes in 3 versions A tobacco pipe, a marijuana pipe, and a frop pipe. All of them are identical gameplay wise since they are just cosmetic items. (I might add object effects to them later on idk.)

# **Where to get em?**

All 3 can be found sitting on a shelf in Doc Mitchell's house. Alternatively if you want to spawn em yourself in the console, the codes to do so can be found here:

| **player.additem XX000ADD 1** | Tobacco Pipe       |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------ |
| **player.additem XX000ADE 1** | **Marijuana Pipe** |
| **player.additem XX000ADF 1** | **Frop Pipe**      |

# **Credits:**

[**Jokerine**](https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Jokerine?gameId=130 "Jokerine")**/Dinky** for creating the Tobacco pipe mesh and textures

**Me** for editing said meshes and textures & creating this mod.
tags: Adds equipable tobacco pipes to the game for your smoking pleasure.

This mod removes all the voice lines from the game. Mod was made and tested in English 1.0 version but with the new update should work on any language version. This mod was not tested with the Lucas Bertone mission. If you have issues with this mod, you can contact me on discord or twitter @PlusProMichal.

**Changelogs:**

The final version is here! Version 2.2 is another hotfix for 2.0 that mutes 1 sound file from Chapter 19 and adds an optional folder with the credits song without the lyrics (used AI to make that one so thats why its optional).

I made a new hotfix update 2.1 that fixes a crash when entering the villa in Visiting Rich People.

New update 2.0 is here: it fixes softlock in Better Get Used To It, mutes people in The Priest and also should mute every voice line in any language version of the game. 

**How to install**:

go into the mafia folder and just put the sounds folder in and replace everything.

Showcase of this mod: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=8Rd-rTq\_jic](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Rd-rTq_jic)

messages.content:
Hungry?  Thirsty?

This mod increases the duration of Fed and Hydration.

That's it, no other changes to the buff.

Fed duration increased to 4 hours.
Hydration duration increased to 2 hours.

Hydration question:  Why only 2 hours?
Hydration Answer:  Because it makes sense to me you would get thirsty faster than hungry.

Note:  

Mod is not retroactive.  If you already had the buff before installing you will need to eat and drink again to see the new duration.

Issues:

This mod does not alter the Food/Drink items to show the new duration, it will still shows 30 minutes on the items. I am not going to fix this as this mod still does what I want it to do and the food showing the un modded duration has no detrimental effect, the timer in your buffs shows correctly.  If it bugs you, feel free to make a patch that fixes it.

Q:  Why increase durations at all?

A:  Because I am an old dude and forget to eat/drink all the time.  Even with the increase I still forget, but at least when I do remember it lasts longer and I don't have to carry as much food that adds weight.
tags: VGB Fed and Hydration Duration Increase
Increases Fed and Hydration buffs by 4/2 hours.
If you want to make a more complicated system using mine as a base, feel free, just be sure to give the proper credit :)

messages.content:
Need a rest?

This mod increases the duration of Well Rested and Emotional Security so you don't have to try to rest every 24 minutes.  

That's it.  There are no other changes or additions.

Well Rested duration increase to 2 hours
Emotional Security duration increase to 4 hours.

Compatibility: 

After switching to .esm I had to make a patch.  With patch verified compatible with Immersive Love Perk by [InquisitorOverhaulsReturn](https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/users/132105373) located here [https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/mods/8837](https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/mods/8837)

I altered the duration, nothing else so it MAY be compatible with others that add bonuses if they don't alter duration.

Other than keeping up with Starfield version updates if necessary, I will not be adding anything else to this mod.
tags: VGB Well Rested and Emotional Security Duration Increase
Increases duration of Well Rested and Emotional Security to 2/4 hours.
